response.original_title: Südtirol - Das Land in der Mitte
response.overview: Imposing mountains, sun-drenched slopes, emerald green valleys – South Tyrol's landscape is predestined to enchant nature lovers.  This “universe” documentary is dedicated to this jewel of the Alps and reveals secrets of its incomparable beauty. With surprising stories and impressive recordings, the renowned nature filmmaker Rolando Menardi invites you to reflect on our relationship to nature in a varied way.
response.title: Südtirol - Das Land in der Mitte
